scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @derrape/client" "npm run dev -w @derrape/server"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @derrape/client -- --host" "npm run dev -w @derrape/server"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @derrape/client && npm run build -w @derrape/server
